Rory: FYI - QA ran the new onboarding flow and we saw dozens of 429s after ~200 concurrent signups. looks like client-side fanout + retries.
Tessa: can you paste a sample tail of the logs?
Rory: sure, snippet: `429 POST /v1/embeds cursor=abc...` repeated, then `401 -> refresh token -> retry` loops.
Ivan: that pattern screams token refresh races + aggressive prefetching. what are sampleapp defaults right now?
Rory: prefetch=4, maxConcurrency=20 in the onboarding template.
Priya: oof. on low-scale infra prefetch 4 floods the server with parallel cursor fetches. recommend drop prefetch to 1 or disable entirely for signup flow.
Tessa: also we have different defaults across SDKs: python-sdk=2, js=4. parity mismatch is confusing for customers.
Ivan: two parallel action items: (1) add a token refresh debounce (singleflight) in all SDKs, (2) align onboarding template to conservative defaults.
Rory: token-refresh singleflight idea (pseudo):
```
let refreshPromise = null;
async function ensureToken() {
  if (!refreshPromise) refreshPromise = doRefresh();
  try { await refreshPromise; } finally { refreshPromise = null; }
}
```
Tessa: also tweak retries: exponential backoff + full jitter for 429s. current linear backoff makes bursts worse.
Priya: agree. propose: base=150ms, max=5000ms, jitter=random(0, sleep). update sampleapp retry policy.
Ivan: another small win: dedupe identical cursor requests for a short window (50ms) so prefetch overlap doesn't cause duplicate RPCs. cheap and effective.
Rory: I'm going to open a tiny PR to sampleapp with prefetch=1, concurrency=8, and updated retry policy.
Tessa: I'll add an SDK util for singleflight token refresh in js + python and tests.
Priya: let's add a debug flag on sampleapp to emit `token_refresh` events and `cursor_dedupe` counters to logs so QA can verify before/after.
ci-bot: CI check: sampleapp/PR#58 created by Rory at 1732109950 - status: pending
Ivan: for communication, update onboarding README with a short note: "If you encounter 429s during signup, reduce client prefetch or enable onboarding-safe mode." keep wording actionable.
Rory: timeline: PRs merged today -> staging deploy -> rerun QA stress test. if results good we can retro back to main template in 48hrs.
Tessa: one more: check server-side batching windows. if server batches small shards aggressively we may need to increase server batch window slightly to absorb fanout. but prefer client-side fixes first.
Priya: documented parity change: sdk defaults will be aligned to prefetch=1 in next patch release. add to changelog.
Rory: thanks all. I'll paste QA graphs after the staging run. :rocket:
ci-bot: sampleapp/PR#58 merged by Rory at 1732110000, deploy scheduled to staging @1732110300
Rory: quick update after staging run - 429s dropped ~85% with the conservative defaults + token lock. will add graphs tomorrow.
